title: Counit equation of ambient exchange
statement: For the ambient exchange of [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-ambient] and any integral or residue derived complex K, its adjunct under the f′ adjunction is the pull-square comparison at Rf(K) followed by g′ pullback of the f counit.

theorem residueExchangeBaseChange_counit (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (K : residueExchangeDerived Λ X) :
    (residueExchangeUpperStar Λ f').map ((residueExchangeBaseChange Λ sq).app K) ≫
      (residueExchangeAdjunction Λ f').counit.app
        ((residueExchangeUpperStar Λ g').obj K) =
    (residueExchangeSquare Λ sq).hom.app ((residueExchangeLowerStar Λ f).obj K) ≫
      (residueExchangeUpperStar Λ g').map ((residueExchangeAdjunction Λ f).counit.app K)
